data.desc: First Mid Bancshares, Inc. ('First Mid') is the parent company of First Mid Bank & Trust, N.A., First Mid Insurance Group, Inc., and First Mid Wealth Management Co. First Mid is a $9.4 billion community-focused organization that provides a full suite of financial services including banking, wealth management, brokerage, Ag services and insurance through a sizeable network of locations throughout Illinois, Iowa, Missouri, Texas and Wisconsin, and a loan production office in the greater Indianapolis area. Together, our First Mid team takes great pride in providing solutions and services to our customers and communities and has done so for more than 160 years.
